# MCP protocol schema test fixtures

These files are test-only snapshots of the generated MCP protocol schemas from
the official
[`modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol`](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol)
repository at commit `5f5440bb26a62e2cf3440b92da5a667efa03b267`.

Each source URL and SHA-256 digest is recorded in `manifest.json`. The snapshots
are used locally by tests; the test suite does not fetch them from the network.

The upstream project distributes these schemas under the Apache License 2.0.
The upstream copyright and license remain applicable to these snapshots.
